statement: Proved scoped base-retaining rank-five theorem. For any actual (++ -> ++) state with gamma4<0, let a=top_2(alpha), c=top_3(p), and d=top_3(v), and put L=binom(d,4)-binom(c+1,4)-binom(a+1,3). Actual legality forces s>=3. The audited gamma4-feedback reduction and the proved high-/low-half adjacent-sum kernel give L>=0 uniformly; since gamma5>=L+1, every such state recovers strictly at rank five while retaining the base word.
